data.long_meaning: Brielle is derived from the Hebrew term briyel, meaning 'strong'. In the Bible, Brielle can be associated with the strong and exalted Biblical character of Sarah. The name also has Greek roots, which translates to 'exalted' or 'high' one. The name Brielle carries the meaning “Strong, Exalted One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Brielle usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Brielle, which means 'strong' in Hebrew, can be a powerful reminder of the strength and power that comes from God. In the Bible, Sarah, the matriarch of the Jewish people, is a strong and exalted woman of faith, who trusted God's promises even in the face of seemingly insurmountable difficulties. Brielle can be a source of inspiration for those who bear this name, reminding them to trust in the strength and power of God, even in the midst of life's challenges. Additionally, the name has Greek roots, which translates to 'exalted' or 'high' one, reflecting the spiritual significance of being called by God and raised up to a higher purpose.
